key_reasoning.reason: 4 production components across 2 layers share new utilities: client-install.ts (installClientWindows, verifyWindowsSignature, windowsApplicationDirs, resolveClaudeDesktopWindows winget-manifest parsing), client-install-step.ts (Windows-aware neededApps/ensureClientsInstalled flow), connect-orchestrator.ts (wires --install-client/--yes through connectTargets), and index.ts (CLI flag plumbing) — plus the matching three test files.

No exact Windows precedent in the codebase: Authenticode signature verification (verifyWindowsSignature) and winget-pkgs YAML manifest parsing are new, extending the existing macOS codesign/teamId pattern (verifyBundle) to a different verification mechanism. Security-sensitive — it fails closed when no winPublisher is configured and double-checks the installer actually placed the app at dest before reporting success — but code comments flag unconfirmed assumptions (winBundle/winPublisher for Claude Desktop 'not yet confirmed against a real install'), so Technical Risk is bumped from M to L.

diffstat reports 9 files changed (670 insertions, 35 deletions) across root (README.md), docs/ (COMMANDS.md), src/cli/commands/proxy/, and src/cli/commands/proxy/__tests__/ — maps to the 7-10 file L band.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): security-sensitive installer-signature verification work (Authenticode check, winget manifest trust) with no exact precedent on Windows in this codebase, and documented unconfirmed assumptions about the real installer's publisher/bundle name.
